# Qiddiya Speed Park

> Qiddiya Speed Park is a motorsport destination taking shape in Qiddiya City, about 50 km west of Riyadh, built around an FIA Grade 1 and FIM Grade A circuit intended to host Formula 1 and MotoGP. The 21-corner track runs anti-clockwise with roughly 108 metres of elevation change per lap and a signature elevated corner, the Blade, rising some 70 metres above the valley floor. Grandstands, hospitality venues and garage facilities sit around the circuit.

## Project Overview

- Category: Hospitality & Landmark Entertainment
- Location: Qiddiya, Saudi Arabia
- Status: On-Going

## MENASCO Scope

Qiddiya Speed Park is a motorsport destination under development in Qiddiya City near Riyadh, centred on a circuit designed by Hermann Tilke with former Formula 1 driver Alexander Wurz and featuring a dramatic elevated first corner known as the Blade. MENASCO is responsible for the MEP works on the Speed Park buildings, supporting a key entertainment asset within Qiddiya City.
